opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as an Ethereum-earning opportunity and then directs viewers into the participation process. Its instructions are not limited to demonstrating a wallet: viewers are told to “click the button at the bottom of the screen and click on the button, Click Join Now,” while another step refers to clicking “the referral link and enter again.” The walkthrough also connects the process to “X3 and X4,” identifying structures tied to the earning process rather than a neutral wallet feature. Finally, it instructs viewers that “here you will be shown the number of network fee given under 005 and press click approve,” directing approval of a network-fee transaction during registration. Taken together, the earning framing, referral-based entry, tiered structures, and required transaction approval establish a recruitment-linked participation opportunity.
